attrs.remaining_trust: That the pinned materials are the artifacts the review actually read. This field previously said `That candidate_count itself is the true size of the delta — it is written by the generator from the pinned artifacts and is NOT recomputed at gate time`, and that named premise is precisely what MUT-INTEGRATION-COUNT-AND-BUCKETS-TRIMMED exploited while the claim shipped PROVED. It is now discharged. What remains is not discharged and is not the same kind of thing: content addressing establishes which bytes were read, never that anyone read them.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a finite domain that is DEFINED by the artifact under test
